That capacity data is not present in the source excerpts retrieved here, so a true unit-cost (CASM) comparison cannot be made from this corpus. As a proxy, I instead compare operating expense as a percentage of revenue (i.e., operating margin), computed from each company's FY2024 revenue and operating income figures disclosed in their 10-Ks [DOC: airlines_costs_fy2024.txt]. Note this proxy blends both cost efficiency and pricing/revenue-mix effects, so it is not a pure cost-structure measure — a carrier with strong pricing power could show a better margin despite a similar or worse true unit cost (CASM) than a peer.
